name: Critical Effects (DH2): Explosive - Arm
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-11 (p. 236). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: The target drops anything held in that hand. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round.
[[1d10]] Weapon Skill damage and [[1d10]] Ballistic Skill damage. Anything carried in that hand is destroyed; if it was an explosive it detonates - resolve result 9 on this table against the target.
Stunned for 1 round. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or suffer Blood Loss. The limb is Useless until medical attention.
Immediate Ordinary (+10) Toughness test. Success: Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill permanently reduced by 1. Failure: gains the Lost Hand condition.
Blood Loss and [[1d5]] levels of Fatigue. The arm is Useless until medical attention.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness test or die from shock. On a success: [[1d10]] levels of Fatigue, Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and Blood Loss. Gains the Lost Arm condition.
The target dies. If he held a weapon with a power source, it explodes: everyone within 2 metres takes a single hit of [[1d10+5]] Impact damage to a random location.

As result 9. In addition, carried ammunition explodes: everyone within [[1d10]] metres takes a single hit of [[1d10+5]] Impact damage to a random location, and any carried grenades or missiles detonate immediately.
